stemMd: Which finding would most weaken the case for a particular disclosure-triggering default?

options.label: A
options.textMd: Nearly all affected customers learn of the default only after their losses occur.

options.label: B
options.textMd: Some informed customers negotiate additional precautions.

options.label: C
options.textMd: The rule is displayed prominently before purchase.

options.label: E
options.textMd: Carriers can offer tailored protection after disclosure.

explanationMd: A rule discovered only after the relevant decision cannot usually induce timely disclosure. The finding attacks the mechanism directly, whereas the other facts make the strategy more plausible.
